admission.justification: The choke's strip-and-cap behavior is proved by the named passing guard cases; as a single-file member it rides the family's joint guarantee.

applicability: The shared tool answer shaping and overflow guard.
conditions: The ordinary projection caps lists at each level through retained items.
The overflow exception applies to an eligible declared list from the validated whole result that fits the measured short answer.
exclusions: The separately recorded whole detail result and whole-result dashboard and command-line surfaces.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_tool_answer_table.py::ToolAnswerLogTests::test_envelope_stripped_from_every_answer + ToolAnswerGuardTests::test_nested_lists_are_cut_through_retained_items (passing in the R6 run); documentary corpus notes/reports/l108-f14-documentary-successor/worker-documentary-evidence.json (SHA 6601bb084849a73554f0e385cf90028966b8bbe07831333cc81529e7b6e89725); A8 documentary corpus notes/reports/l108-f14-documentary-successor-a8/worker-documentary-evidence.json

statement: Default answer shaping strips the four envelope fields and recursively caps ordinary lists through retained items, preserving order, counts and location. The overflow guard can retain a correctly typed declared list from the validated whole result in full when it fits. Answer shaping leaves the whole detail result intact.
